notes: The next version of an encrypted folder's key, after someone lost the folder (todo.rekey in GET /api/keys): made on the device of someone who holds the newest version, sealed for them and for the recovery key. New uploads seal their file keys for it; older files keep theirs. Errors: 409 key_outdated unless version is the next one, 404 not_found for a folder the caller holds no newest key of.
